title: skills: operations.md still names `--runtime` for `os package install` after #30126 row 13 renames it to `-u/--url`
body:
domain:server#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czvZykUqhYxYXSSDt4

Ruling A on #30126 row 13 (record 6674432613): `os package install` drops `-r/--runtime` with no alias. `-u/--url` replaces it, and `-t/--token` is added. That is BREAKING. The code PR for #30126 (server seat 4) keeps `skills/**` out so that it stays ungoverned (claim amendment 6674762721). ⛔ Not a claim.

`skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md:106`, the `os package install` row, reads `[--version │ --runtime http://localhost:3000]`. Once the rename lands, that line is wrong.

Expected: the row names `-u/--url` (and `-t/--token` if the row lists credentials), with `'@objectstack/skills': patch`. `skills/**` is Tier H.

Serial: after the #30126 code PR merges. Land it before the next release, because the rename ships BREAKING.
